landing.badge: AI placement prep, grounded in your real resume
landing.title: Walk into placement season ready.
landing.subtitle: Score your resume, fix what is weak with truthful edits, and rehearse interviews built around your own projects. Your college only sees aggregate readiness — never your private data.
landing.trust: Built for placement cells · DPDP-aligned · Aggregate by default
landing.feature1Body: Five subscores, job-tailored suggestions and accept/reject diffs. The AI may rephrase your evidence, never invent it.
landing.feature2Body: Three rounds, adaptive follow-ups and a fixed rubric you can read before you start. No mystery scoring.
landing.feature3Title: Readiness your cell can act on
landing.feature3Body: Department heatmaps, weakest skills and a one-click PDF — aggregate-only unless you opt in.
landing.previewSubtitle: A dashboard built for late-night prep on a phone.

auth.loginSubtitle: Pick up where you left off. Your streak is waiting.
auth.signupSubtitle: One account, grounded feedback, and control over what your college can see.
auth.name: Full name
auth.collegeCodeHint: e.g. NOVA. Ask your placement cell if you are unsure.
auth.demoHint: One click, seeded data, no password. Available because DEMO_MODE is on.
auth.privacyBody: We store your resume and interview transcript to power your feedback. Officers only see aggregate cohort statistics by default. You can opt in to share your individual readiness, and you can delete your account and all associated data at any time.
auth.consentNotice: I have read the privacy notice and agree to processing for placement preparation.
auth.shareAnalytics: Share my individual readiness with my placement cell
auth.shareHint: Off by default. Aggregate analytics are unaffected by this choice.
auth.consentRequired: Please accept the privacy notice to continue.
auth.genericError: Could not sign you in. Please try again.

onboarding.welcomeSub: Three quick steps. Your first resume score is the win.
onboarding.branchSub: This helps us benchmark you fairly and show your cell the right heatmap.
onboarding.roleSub: We tailor questions, skills and resume suggestions to this role.
onboarding.resumeSub: PDF or DOCX, up to 5 MB. You get a score in under a minute.
onboarding.analyzing: Reading your resume and scoring it…
onboarding.resumeOptional: You can add or replace your resume any time.

dashboard.focus: Here is what moves your readiness today.
dashboard.emptyHistory: No activity yet. Upload a resume to get your first score.
dashboard.emptyBody: Upload a resume and take one interview. We will fill in the readiness ring, radar and history.

resume.title: Resume studio
resume.subtitle: Score it, then make truthful, targeted edits you control.
resume.uploadHint: PDF or DOCX · max 5 MB · text-based PDFs parse best
resume.noResumesBody: Upload a PDF or DOCX to get your first score in under a minute.
resume.jdHint: Paste a JD for sharper tailoring. Leave empty to target your chosen role.
resume.suggestionsHint: Accept only what is true. Rejected edits are discarded.
resume.noSuggestions: No safe edits found — that is a good sign.
resume.missingHint: Add these only if they are true. We will never write them for you.
resume.injectionWarning: Instruction-like text was detected in the resume. It was ignored during scoring.
resume.needsReviewBody: This looks like a scanned document. Paste a text-based version for the best results.
resume.emptyBody: Upload a resume, add a job description, and run the analysis. First win takes under a minute.
resume.analyzeAnother: Score again with a new JD
resume.errorUpload: Upload failed. Check the type, size and that it is not password-protected.

interviews.title: Mock interviews
interviews.subtitle: Three rounds. A visible rubric. Feedback you can act on.
interviews.rubricTitle: The rubric you will be scored on
interviews.rubricHint: Read it now. It is fixed before you start and cannot be changed by the model.
interviews.noResumeBody: Interviews are grounded in your projects, so we need a resume to begin.
interviews.emptyBody: Your first three-round interview takes about ten minutes.
interviews.hint: Interviews use your latest resume. You can change it before starting.
interviews.varianceHint: The model disagreed with itself. A human should review this score.
interviews.answerPlaceholder: Type your answer. Be specific: what did you build, what trade-off did you make, what changed?
interviews.allRoundsBody: Finish to get your median rubric score and detailed feedback.
interviews.error: The room hit a problem. Your progress is saved — rejoin to continue.

feedback.title: Interview feedback
feedback.subtitle: Transcript on the left, rubric on the right. Nothing hidden.
feedback.variance: This score varied across samples and is flagged for human review.
feedback.emptyBody: Finish the interview to unlock rubric feedback.

officer.title: Placement readiness
officer.subtitle: Aggregate signal for your cohort. No individual data unless a student opts in.
officer.heatmapHint: Average rubric score by branch · 100 scale
officer.funnelHint: How the cohort moves from signup to ready
officer.cohortHint: Interviews and average score by week
officer.studentsHint: Named rows require the student's opt-in
officer.hiddenNote: This student has chosen not to share individual data.
officer.privacyNote: Students control individual visibility. Aggregates always include everyone, so cohort insights stay accurate.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.subtitle: Colleges, question bank, rubric versions and AI usage.
admin.globalNote: Global questions are read-only once created.
admin.newRubricHint: Starts from the standard five-criterion rubric. Weights must sum to 1.0.
admin.usageHint: Tokens and cost per college, per month
admin.error: That action failed. Check the values and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your data, your choices.
settings.shareTitle: Share individual readiness with my cell
settings.shareBody: When on, your placement officer can see your name, readiness and interview count. Off by default.
settings.retentionBody: Resumes and transcripts are kept while your account is active. You can delete everything from this page. Raw audio is not collected in Phase 1; Phase 2 voice recordings will be deleted immediately after transcription. Aggregate statistics may be retained after deletion because they contain no personal data.
settings.usageBody: We meter every model call. When your monthly budget is exhausted, AI features pause until the 1st.
settings.deleteBody: Removes your account, resumes, analyses, interviews and scores. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteSuccess: Your account and data have been deleted.
settings.languageBody: Switch the interface language. Your choice is stored on this device.
settings.themeBody: Dark is the default. Light mode is one tap away.
